page.layout: One map plate: a fortification plan of Groningen, with the printed labels set on the engraving. The plate is cut off at the right edge. No text blocks, margins or page numbers.
page.notes: The plate is cut off at the right edge, so labels such as "GROEN", "Prinsh", "Iaco", "Ceestl: M", "Academ", "A.P" and "Boom diep" are incomplete and read as far as visible. "Wech na Lieuwarde" is uncertain: the last letters are not clear on the scan. "Boom" at the bottom right is partly hidden. The compass rose has no text. A "Google" watermark at the bottom right is the digitiser's mark and is left out.
